text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, multi-sentence argument with several developed body paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"It presents and expands more ideas, with reasons that are carried through multiple sentences rather than only briefly stated."},{"evidence":"more varied transition words like \"first,\" \"second,\" \"also,\" \"in the end\"","quality":"coherence","description":"It organizes ideas more clearly with explicit linking of points across paragraphs and sentences."},{"evidence":"sentence patterns such as \"Hiring someone who doesn't have experience... can be a good thing\" and \"New employees need a mentor\"","quality":"syntactic control","description":"It shows somewhat more control over sentence structure and combines ideas in more varied ways."},{"evidence":"uses words and phrases like \"adapt,\" \"mentor,\" \"professional,\" \"leadership skills,\" \"skill diversity\"","quality":"vocabulary range","description":"It uses a broader set of academic and workplace-related terms to express its ideas."},{"evidence":"fewer awkward constructions than \"I oppose to extending\" and \"practice their homework\"","quality":"grammatical control","description":"It has somewhat fewer severe grammar and word-choice problems that interfere with clear meaning."}]}
